title: One place directory
description: Centralizes every screenshot, world, and server folder into multiple configurable directories.
body:
This mod allows you to **centralize your Minecraft data folders** into multiple configurable locations.

### Features

- 🔧 **Customizable general directory**:
  - Acts as a fallback if no specific directory is set for a category.
- 🖼️ **Dedicated folder paths per category** (optional overrides):
  - **Screenshots**
  - **Multiplayer server list**
  - **Singleplayer world saves**
- 🧩 **Compatible with config GUI mods** like [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for easy setup.

> ⚠️ **Currently, only screenshots are centralized.**  
> Support for world saves and servers will be added in future updates.
